lc_person: Lazarʹ Solomonovich Kheĭfet︠s︡ (Lazar Jeifets), born 1946; historian of Latin America and the Comintern, author of Latinskai︠a︡ Amerika v orbite Kominterna (2000).
item_person: Lazar Solomonovich Kheyfets (Хейфец, Лазарь Соломонович), born 1946; historian and professor associated with American studies at Saint Petersburg State University.

evidence.says: LC gives the full heading Kheĭfet︠s︡, L. S. (Lazarʹ Solomonovich), 1946-, Cyrillic form Хейфец, Лазарь Соломонович, and variant Jeifets, Lazar. Its 2000 book citation expands the initials to Lazarʹ Solomonovich; its 2004 citation for La internacional comunista y América Latina, 1919-1943 reports birth in 1946. LC links Q18786173, VIAF 50393904 and GND 13264780X.

The item labels the person Lazar Kheyfets, with alias Lazar Solomonovich Kheyfets and Russian label Хейфец, Лазарь Соломонович. It records birth year 1946, historian among its occupations, LC n00102466, VIAF 50393904, GND 13264780X and ORCID 0000-0001-6376-7813.
Saint Petersburg State University lists Хейфец, Лазарь Соломонович as a professor in its Department of American Studies, with publications on Cuban and Venezuelan history and relations.
